findings.description: V211's extended body-surface support now covers the gray thigh areas almost to both knees in sit and crouch. The separate shorts-like edges do not join into the lilac overskirt hem: the outer hem still folds beside and behind the knees and leaves the center of the lap without a continuous edge. Keep the longer support layer and carry a shaped front panel from the waist across both thighs while retaining one connected outer hem.

The prone render still stacks several folds beneath the hips. Both standing profiles retain a stepped front outline between the hip and hem. Shape and inspect the front transition after the lap-spanning panel is added.

nextAction: Keep the V211 thigh support shell at its longer hem, then add or reshape an authored front-lap panel that spans both flexed thighs and reconnects to the continuous skirt hem at both sides. Reduce the prone folds and stepped side outline, then inspect all five views and six poses. UV remains NOT_CREATED for the body-surface support shell. Fit, Shape Key response, production rig/weights, Unity/VRChat behavior, package and release remain unverified.
